# Kone Digital

> High-Performance Website as a Service (WaaS), Cloud Systems, and Digital Engineering Agency.

Kone Digital builds lightning-fast bespoke web applications, e-commerce storefronts, mobile apps, and automated WhatsApp CRM lead capture funnels for ambitious businesses in Ghana and worldwide.

## Core Capabilities & Services

- [Custom Web & SaaS Engineering](https://digital.koneacademy.io/#services/web-development) - React, Next.js, and bespoke enterprise web architectures.
- [Mobile App Development](https://digital.koneacademy.io/#services/mobile-apps) - High-performance iOS and Android applications.
- [Brand Design & UI/UX Systems](https://digital.koneacademy.io/#services/brand-design) - Identity systems, interactive design guidelines, and design tokens.
- [Cloud & DevOps Infrastructure](https://digital.koneacademy.io/#services/cloud-devops) - Scalable cloud hosting, CI/CD pipelines, and microservices.
- [Client Work & Case Studies](https://digital.koneacademy.io/#work) - Portfolio of live production apps and client transformations.
- [Transparent Pricing](https://digital.koneacademy.io/#pricing) - Predictable fixed-price and subscription tiers for digital products.

## Parent Ecosystem

- [Kone Academy Main Hub](https://www.koneacademy.io/) - Multidisciplinary innovation and technology collective.
